senses.gloss:
गोव गोव, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), N. of a
country; (also read कुव.)

गोवय गोवय, nom. P. (a corruption fr.
गोपय), गोवयति, -यितुम्, to keep back, to pre-
vent from approaching.

गोवाल गोवाल, अस्, m., N. of a man; (per-
haps a corruption fr. गो-पाल); [cf. also गोबाल.]

गोविचन्द्र गोविचन्द्र, अस्, m., N. of a
prince; (the names of the other princes of the same
dynasty ending in चन्द्र, this word may be a comp.
fr. गोवि and चन्द्र, गोवि being probably contracted
fr. गो and अवि.)
गोविन्द गो-विन्द. See under गो, p. 299.
